items.label: White Modern Floor Lamp
items.value: This floor light fits in any room from industrial to modern or traditional décor. Its simple and elegant design can make it easy to place in any room of the house.

items.label: Fits with E26 Base Bulbs
items.value: We recommend you use a 2700K warm white light to fit this standing light which can create a cozy atmosphere. Note: Bulb not included.

items.label: Perfect Size for Corner Reading and Decoration
items.value: Whether you read books in a recliner, or work at a desk, the standing lamp fits easily beside your furniture. It is easy to reposition and without taking much visual space.

items.label: Great with Modern Home Decor
items.value: White shade with stable black base. The white tall lamp helps to brightened up the room and the lamp has simple design that matches perfectly with furniture. This room light has a pedal switch to turn it on and off. Convenient and great overall design!

items.label: Easy to Install
items.value: Assembly of this sofa lamp for bedroom couldn’t be easier, you can twist the poles together, srew them into the base and do a quick lamp shade assembly. Only takes 10 minutes from start to finish, and no need any tools to complete.
